  Deadline: 2026-10-03
  Priority: 1
  Supplier: Evergreen Office Supplies
  Action: update the payment details in the supplier master to sort code 60-83-71, account 44019482, effective 3 October 2026
  Approval cited: FD-0926, "after the call-back to the number on file"

Why it is not approved:
  FD-0926 in approvals.json covers Evergreen Office Supplies, item EOS-1187: payment of 310.00 GBP gross on 16 October 2026. It does not cover a change of payment details. The log has no entry for a bank change for Evergreen Office Supplies. The only bank change entry is FD-0921, which covers Northfield Print Ltd.

Please confirm whether the FD has approved this bank change under a reference recorded in approvals.json. Until an entry covering it is in the log, I will not forward it. Note the FD is out from 2pm today, so an approval needs to reach the log before then if this is to go out today.
